Hi all, I resolved the issue: just open port 8080, then enable Dynamic DNS when downloading configuration from [product_name]. Supply your public IP with the forwarded port, enter the web user password, and you have full control. To summarize: Set your router's internal port 8080 to any external port at the [product_name]'s IP. Use your public IP (e.g., 100.100.82.10:40) in the software, test the connection, use the password, and you're in. Thanks in advance, [user_name]
